activity.notes: Chief Isaac led the Tr'ondëk Hwëch'in before the Klondike gold rush and until his death in 1932. The gold-rush period around 1896 is a representative, approximate activity boundary, not an invented accession date. The political community is the specific Hän community at Tr'ochëk/Moosehide, not all Hän-speaking peoples.
